name: SortFree Weighting
definition: An Order-Independent Transparency (OIT) approximation that replaces depth sorting with a commutative weighted-sum blending scheme, weighting Gaussians by depth and view direction.
summary: SortFree Weighting is an order-independent transparency approximation for 3D Gaussian Splatting that replaces depth sorting with commutative weighted-sum blending to enable parallel accumulation.
